The Lenses of Creation

Before the Collapse, the structure of reality was not random.

It followed a pattern.

Ancient traditions describe this pattern as the Sephirotic System, sometimes called the Tree of Life.

Within the structure of Adam Kadmon, the forces that shaped existence flowed through a set of interconnected principles known as the Sephirot.

Each Sephirah represented a different aspect of creation — wisdom, strength, balance, foundation, and more.

Together they formed the architecture through which the world functioned.

When these principles worked in harmony, reality remained stable.

When their balance was broken, the system began to fail.

The Vessels That Burst

In the mystical traditions that survived the Collapse, the Sephirot are often described as vessels that once held the divine light of creation.

When the structure of Adam Kadmon failed, these vessels shattered.

The light they once contained scattered across reality.

Fragments of their structure remain throughout the world, but the harmony that once held them together is gone.

This event is sometimes called the Breaking of the Vessels.

It is one of the deepest explanations scholars offer for why the world fractured during the Collapse.

The Lenses of Creation

Because the traditional language surrounding the Sephirot can be difficult to understand, many explorers describe them in a simpler way.

They call them Lenses.

Each Sephirah acted like a lens through which the creative energy of the universe passed.

Just as a lens focuses light, each Sephirah shaped the divine energy flowing through reality into a specific form.

One lens might shape that energy into wisdom.

Another into strength.

Another into harmony or compassion.

Together, these lenses created the balanced system that once sustained the world.

The Fractured Lenses

When the Collapse shattered the structure of Adam Kadmon, these lenses fractured.

Some of their energy still flows through the world.

But it is no longer perfectly balanced.

In some regions, one lens dominates.

In others, its influence is missing entirely.

This imbalance contributes to many of the strange phenomena found across the hexes.

Magic behaves unpredictably.

Communities develop unusual philosophical traditions.

Certain places resonate strongly with particular aspects of creation.

These are all echoes of the shattered lenses.

The Tree of Life

The Sephirotic System is often represented as a diagram known as the Tree of Life.

This pattern shows how the different Sephirot connect to one another.

Each principle influences the others, forming a network that once maintained the balance of reality.

In ancient texts, the Tree of Life is described as the blueprint through which the world was originally structured.

Many scholars believe that understanding this pattern may be the key to repairing the deeper systems damaged during the Collapse.

The Ten Lenses

Traditional teachings describe ten Sephirot, each representing a different aspect of creation.

They are often interpreted as:

Keter — The Crown
The source from which all creation emerges.

Chokhmah — Soul
The spark of insight and inspiration.

Binah — Understanding
The ability to shape and interpret knowledge.

Chesed — Mercy
Expansion, generosity, and growth.

Gevurah — Violence
Discipline, restraint, and power.

Tiferet — Harmony
Balance between opposing forces.

Netzach — Victory
Endurance, ambition, and persistence.

Hod — Glory
Structure, communication, and knowledge.

Yesod — Foundation
The connection that binds systems together.

Malkuth — Kingdom
The physical world where all forces manifest.

Together these lenses once focused the energy of creation into a stable reality.

The Broken Balance

Since the Collapse, the balance between these forces has been deeply disturbed.

Some regions resonate strongly with particular aspects of the system.

Others seem almost completely disconnected from it.

This imbalance is one of the reasons the world remains unstable.

Understanding how the lenses interact may be one of the keys to restoring harmony.

The Sephirotic Mystery

Despite centuries of study, the true nature of the Sephirotic System remains uncertain.

Were the Sephirot metaphysical forces?

Cosmic structures?

A language used to describe how the universe organizes itself?

No one knows for certain.

But fragments of their influence continue to shape the world.

And those who seek to repair reality believe the answers may lie within the pattern they once formed.

The Lenses and the Great Work

Many scholars believe that the Great Work is ultimately about restoring the balance between the fractured lenses.

Each repaired hex.

Each stabilized leyline.

Each restored community.

These acts may slowly bring the broken structure of the Sephirotic system closer to harmony again.

If that is true, then the Great Work is not only about rebuilding the world.

It is about refocusing the light of creation through the lenses that once held it together.

In Simple Terms

The Sephirotic System describes the deep pattern through which creation was once organized.

These forces acted like lenses focusing the energy of reality into balance.

When the Collapse shattered the structure of Adam Kadmon, the lenses fractured as well.

Understanding how they once worked may be one of the keys to restoring the world.
